pool.concept: At a tide-wet harbor ferry vestibule, a lone floral courier steadies a fragile flowering branch crate across the narrow gap from quay to ferry while the gate waits half-open.
Inside a stopped night-mail carriage, a lone attendant releases the last gold-edged botanical keepsake case from a sorting shelf while dawn reaches through the carriage-door seam.
At the upper funicular station after rain, a lone conservator carefully unloads a shallow white-blossom specimen case while cable hardware and mountain mist frame her waiting hands.
At a quiet cargo terminal inspection table, a lone messenger verifies a gold-framed botanical glass crate while its hinged lid holds a reflection of the opening loading-bay light.
On the narrow service platform of an old canal lock, a lone courier pauses with a flowering travel case as a passing barge shifts the water and a mooring line settles taut.
At the final turning loop of an old city tram, a lone flower-delivery traveler stands just inside the tram door, holding a shallow blossom crate as the driverless empty carriage settles at its stop.
At a dim railway luggage lift, a lone delivery attendant lowers a hinged floral display case from a brass-edged trolley to the lift threshold as the lift door admits a slender band of warm light.

baseline_to_final_literal_delta.baseline_overlap_causal_limit: The baseline already had gothic serenity, black botanical lace, flowers, a dark floral clasp, subdued gold and ivory light, and tram cargo care. pixel_theme_observations.overall_impression_without_intensity_lab: A hushed, attentive traveler in a dark ornate tram doorway handles a pale flowering branch. Warm brass edges and rain-lit street rails give the dark floral clothing a romantic, grounded stillness. The first reading follows face, collar ornament and flowers; the hand task ties them together.
pixel_theme_observations.compare_to_frozen_controls: The human appeal reads as a subtle supporting intimacy through lowered attention, softly parted mouth and delicate handling. The frame does not appear to use a fetish focus or an impossible relationship. This is agent perception rather than a numerical intensity proof or user preference.
pixel_theme_observations.reference_cues: The short dark jaw-level bob, separated wispy forehead fringe, dark eyes and general facial proportions are visibly carried into the new pose. This is appearance comparison, not identity confirmation or an inference about the reference person age or personality.
pixel_theme_observations.scene_readability: The open tram door, rain, curving rail, open cargo case and stem held over the case support a pause during arrival/flower transport. The actual delivery destination and precise preceding jolt are not established by pixels.
pixel_theme_observations.baseline_overlap: Quiet expression, black botanical lace, live flowers, generic collar flower ornament, golden/ivory light and tram cargo care already existed in the frozen baseline. Their presence does not demonstrate a new-DATA causal effect.
pixel_theme_observations.staging_variations: The lower supporting hand reads as a case handle/front-edge grip rather than an unequivocal flat palm under the whole baseboard. The case extends beyond the left frame edge, and the feet/floor threshold are cropped. These authorial staging variations preserve the visible case support, stem contact and new material relationship.
